title: Task 10 — live resolve embeddings (pokemon-lore/kanto)
command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 PYTHONPATH=scripts .venv/bin/python scripts/pipeline/resolve_entities.py --domain pokemon-lore --editions kanto --device cuda:0 --auto-band 0.92 --review-band 0.85 --review-cap 50

auto_merge_collapse.note: essentially ALL characters collapsed into one mega-cluster
all regions collapsed; kanto region lost

finding: GARBAGE. auto_band=0.92 on mean-pooled roberta-large short display names is far too loose for this corpus: within each (entity_type, continuity) bucket, pairwise cosine ≥ 0.92 for nearly everything, so union-find collapses each type into a single mega-cluster. review_band=0.85 never fires because pairs jump straight past auto. No semantic aliases of the useful kind surfaced — only total collapse. Exact-name path remains the usable resolver for kanto.

suggested_next_experiments: raise auto_band to ≥0.98 (or disable auto entirely; review-only)
embed 'name + entity_type + one-line desc' instead of bare name
cap auto-merge group size (e.g. refuse groups >3 without operator)
use review_band-only with a tight window (0.97–0.99) and non-empty review.jsonl adjudication
